_meta.status: DRAFT rule-of-thumb rotation rules (family-based). Needs agronomist review.

notes.pest_break: Repeating the same crop (or family) in consecutive years raises disease and pest pressure; a break of one or more years lowers it. Score = 1 - penalties across consecutive pairs (including the wrap-around year).
notes.n_credit: A legume's fixed N partly carries to the next crop (fraction above), reducing the fertilizer N the next cereal needs.
